name: Takabe Eri
source:
She is a first-year student in the violin department of Shukusei Music Academy. Her grandfather was the founder of a major department store, and her father is the chairman of the Takabe Group. She is a rich lady among rich ladies, but she is by no means a naive girl.
She doesn't like being thought of as a rich lady by others, and she always wanted to be an ordinary girl. She is a talented girl with a strong sense of justice, who is both kind and strict. Her intuition is outstanding.


[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/19980701104740/http://www.elf-game.co.jp/special/syusaku/syusaku12.htm]the game's website, archived[/url]]
